summary: All four task goals are met and verification is green. Docs are consolidated and accurate to the current implementation: README.md documents only real APIs (AppLensUI + AppLens.initialize/trackEvent/isEnabled/getVersion/getConfig/getStorage/loadKnowledgeGraph/getKnowledgeGraph/attach-/detachInterceptors/reset) all grep-confirmed in src/, the config table matches AppLensConfig field-for-field (persistLogs/verboseLogging marked reserved, projectRoot noted reserved), the redaction section matches the shipped header+body behavior, and the local-provider stub claim is corrected (no canned guidance). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md has the Implementation Status table, phases 1-11 roadmap, 'Do not build yet' list, and spec-vs-code divergence table; DELIVERY.md is reduced to a pointer; no 'Triveni' appears anywhere; version strings agree at 0.2.1 across package.json, getVersion(), SettingsTab footer, README, DELIVERY, and CHANGELOG. The Example app ships 7 deterministic AI Test Lab scenarios (ShopDemo framing) with tap-to-copy suggested questions and no invented prefilled-prompt API, each wrapped so it still logs/tracks offline and never crashes; Example/README.md documents every scenario's question and expected grounded answer plus an offline note. The src/ changes are minimal and justified: version bump (3 consistent locations), redactFields export, and best-effort JSON body-field redaction wired into both the XHR and fetch paths of NetworkInterceptor (never throws, leaves non-JSON bodies untouched). Verification: library `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0, Example `npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0, Example `npx jest` 2/2 suites pass, eslint on changed Example files reports 0 errors.

findings.detail: eslint reports one pre-existing warning (react/no-unstable-nested-components) on the inline tabBarIcon component in AppNavigator.tsx line 53. Confirmed pre-existing on HEAD: this task only added an icon `else if` branch and a new <Tab.Screen> for the AI Lab tab, not the unstable-nested-component pattern itself. Out of scope for this diff; non-blocking. Could be addressed in a separate cleanup by hoisting the tabBarIcon renderer out of screenOptions.
